title_zh: 雷暴席卷伊拉克，造成致命洪水袭击

summary_zh: 猛烈风暴袭击伊拉克北部和伊朗部分地区，葡萄牙面临强风，日本准备迎接进一步降雪
body_en: Deadly floods hit Iraq as thunderstorms sweep across region | Environment
Violent storms lash northern Iraq and parts of Iran, while Portugal faces strong winds and Japan braces for further snowfall

Deadly flash floods hit northern Iraq on Saturday as severe thunderstorms swept across the region, including in neighbouring Iran. The city of Erbil, in Iraq, was particularly badly hit, with extensive damage to homes and businesses. Streets were inundated as torrential rain fell over a short period.
Rainfall exceeded forecasts, with an estimated 80mm falling in the city, compared with expectations of 30mm. Two people were killed in the floods.

In Europe, Storm Bruna is forecast to bring strong winds to Portugal this week, particularly along the west coast. Gusts are expected to reach 50mph (80km/h), with heavy rain and thunderstorms also expected. The total rainfall could reach 200mm by the end of the week. The storm has already affected the Canary Islands, where Tenerife recorded a gust of 80mph on Saturday night.
Japan experienced a cold and snowy end to last week, with further snowfall expected in Hokkaido and parts of the mountains in the main island Honshu.

Temperatures in Japan are forecast to fall below the seasonal average early this week, with Sapporo, the capital of Hokkaido prefecture, expected to plunge to 10C below average. Maximum temperatures in the city are likely to be about 4-6C on Monday and Wednesday, while Tuesday’s high is forecast to be about 0C. Minimum temperatures could fall to -6C by Wednesday, and -8C in other western parts of Hokkaido on Tuesday.
Ski resorts are preparing for visitors after snowfall began on Friday. Total snowfall is expected to reach 30-50cm around Kiroro and Niesko, with about 20-30cm in Furano, Rusutsu and Sapporo.
Other resorts could receive up to 20cm of snow by Wednesday. Strong winds accompanied the snow on Friday and over the weekend, with gusts of about 75mph in Kiroko and Niesko.

During the strong El Niño, sea surface temperatures in the equatorial Pacific were about 3.5C above the climatological average at their peak in late October. As a result, Peru has been experiencing air temperatures 5-10C above the seasonal average. The unusually warm conditions expected to continue into next week.
body_zh: 伊拉克遭遇致命洪水，雷暴席卷整个地区环境
猛烈风暴袭击伊拉克北部和伊朗部分地区，葡萄牙面临强风，日本准备迎接进一步降雪
周六，致命的山洪袭击了伊拉克北部，严重的雷暴席卷了该地区，包括邻国伊朗。伊拉克埃尔比勒市受到的打击尤其严重，房屋和企业遭到严重破坏。短时间的倾盆大雨导致街道被淹没。
降雨量超出预期，预计该市降雨量为 80 毫米，而预期为 30 毫米。两人在洪水中丧生。
在欧洲，预计风暴布鲁纳本周将给葡萄牙带来强风，特别是西海岸。阵风预计将达到 50 英里/小时（80 公里/小时），预计还会有大雨和雷暴。到本周末总降雨量可能达到200毫米。风暴已经影响了加那利群岛，特内里费岛周六晚上录得时速 80 英里的阵风。
日本上周经历了寒冷多雪的天气，北海道和本州岛部分山区预计还会有进一步降雪。
预计本周初日本气温将降至季节性平均水平以下，其中北海道首府札幌的气温预计将降至平均水平以下 10 摄氏度。周一和周三该市最高气温可能约为 4-6 摄氏度，预计周二最高气温约为 0 摄氏度。周三最低气温可能降至-6℃，周二北海道西部其他地区最低气温可能降至-8℃。
周五降雪后，滑雪胜地正在为游客做准备。预计Kiroro和Niesko周围的总降雪量将达到30-50厘米，富良野、留寿都和札幌的降雪量约为20-30厘米。
到周三，其他度假村的降雪量可能会达到 20 厘米。周五和周末，强风伴随着降雪，Kiroko 和 Niesko 的阵风时速约为 75 英里/小时。
强厄尔尼诺现象期间，赤道太平洋海面温度比10月下旬峰值时的气候平均值高出约3.5摄氏度。因此，秘鲁的气温比季节平均水平高出 5 至 10 摄氏度。异常温暖的天气预计将持续到下周。

title_en: Trial date of alleged Charlie Kirk killer set for June 2028
title_zh: 涉嫌杀害查理·柯克的凶手的审判日期定于 2028 年 6 月
summary: Tyler Robinson has pleaded not guilty to aggravated murder and six other charges in connection with the 2025 killing of the conservative activist.
summary_zh: 泰勒·罗宾逊 (Tyler Robinson) 对与 2025 年杀害保守派活动人士有关的严重谋杀罪和其他六项指控表示不认罪。
body_en: Tyler Robinson: Trial date of alleged Charlie Kirk shooter set for June 2028 - BBC News
The trial of Tyler Robinson, the man accused of killing conservative activist Charlie Kirk, will start in June 2028, a judge has ordered.
Robinson, 23, has pleaded not guilty to aggravated murder and six other charges in connection with the September 2025 killing of Kirk, 31, who was shot while he spoke at a Utah college campus.

Utah County judge Tony Graf Jr on Monday told the court that jury selection would begin on 21 June, 2028. The prosecution has estimated the trial could last 17 weeks, while defence lawyers have said it could take seven months.
Robinson could face the death penalty if found guilty of aggravated murder, something his defence team has sought to prevent.
Prosecutors previously told the court they could be ready for trial by October 2027 but were willing to move that date back to January 2028 to avoid the holiday period.

But defence attorneys said they needed more time to prepare their case and floated a 2029 start. As well as trying to stop Robinson facing the death penalty, they have also tried to have cameras banned from the courtroom.

Kirk's widow, Erika, with whom he had two children, had pushed for as early a trial date as possible while also arguing proceedings should be live-streamed. She, along with Kirk's parents, ⁠Robert and Kathryn, have attended a number of court hearings in the case.

At the end of Monday's proceedings, Erica Kirk's lawyer, Jeffrey A Nieman, told the judge that while "a trial in the summer of 2028, three years after Charlie's assassination, does not feel very speedy to the Kirk family", they had "no choice but obviously to accept the schedule the court's put forward".
Nieman added: "The family has waited long enough already; they should not have to wait any longer for this."
During a five-day preliminary hearing in July, prosecutors outlined their evidence to show probable cause for trial.

This included DNA allegedly tying Robinson to the murder weapon and other items recovered at the scene; confessions he allegedly made to loved ones; and a taped video statement from his roommate and romantic partner, Lance Twiggs.
"There is a mountain of evidence that proves that he is the shooter," prosecutor Ryan McBride told the court in September.

"We know that the defendant is the shooter… first, because of the video evidence; second, because of the DNA; third, because of his admissions; and fourth, because of circumstantial evidence," McBride said.
Defence attorneys, meanwhile, have cast doubt upon evidence and expert witness credentials in the case.
Charlie Kirk murder suspect pleads not guilty as judge clears way for death penalty trial
body_zh: 泰勒·罗宾逊：查理·柯克枪击案嫌疑人的审判日期定于 2028 年 6 月 - BBC 新闻
法官下令，对被控杀害保守派活动人士查理·柯克的泰勒·罗宾逊 (Tyler Robinson) 的审判将于 2028 年 6 月开始。
23 岁的罗宾逊对与 2025 年 9 月杀害 31 岁的柯克有关的严重谋杀罪和其他六项指控表示不认罪，柯克在犹他州一所大学校园演讲时被枪杀。
犹他县法官托尼·格拉夫 (Tony Graf Jr) 周一告诉法庭，陪审团遴选将于 2028 年 6 月 21 日开始。检方估计审判可能持续 17 周，而辩护律师表示可能需要 7 个月。
如果被判犯有严重谋杀罪，罗宾逊可能面临死刑，而他的辩护团队一直试图阻止这种情况的发生。
检察官此前告诉法庭，他们可能会在 2027 年 10 月之前做好审判准备，但愿意将这一日期推迟到 2028 年 1 月，以避免假期。
但辩护律师表示，他们需要更多时间来准备案件，并提出从 2029 年开始。除了试图阻止罗宾逊面临死刑之外，他们还试图禁止摄像机进入法庭。
柯克的遗孀埃里卡（Erika）与柯克育有两个孩子，她极力推动审判日期尽可能早，同时也主张诉讼过程应该进行直播。她与柯克的父母罗伯特和凯瑟琳一起出席了该案的多次法庭听证会。
在周一的诉讼程序结束时，埃里卡·柯克的律师杰弗里·A·尼曼告诉法官，虽然“在查理被暗杀三年后的 2028 年夏天进行审判，柯克家族感觉不是很快”，但他们“别无选择，只能接受法院提出的时间表”。
尼曼补充道：“家人已经等得够久了；他们不应该再等了。”
在七月份为期五天的初步听证会上，检察官概述了他们的证据，以表明可能的审判理由。
其中包括据称将罗宾逊与凶器和现场发现的其他物品绑在一起的 DNA；据称他向亲人供述；以及他的室友兼浪漫伴侣兰斯·特威格斯（Lance Twiggs）的录音视频声明。
“有大量证据证明他就是枪手，”检察官瑞安·麦克布莱德 (Ryan McBride) 9 月份在法庭上表示。
“我们知道被告就是枪手……首先，因为视频证据；第二，因为 DNA；第三，因为他的供认；第四，因为间接证据，”麦克布莱德说。
与此同时，辩护律师对该案的证据和专家证人资格表示怀疑。

title_en: Russia's leading independent newspaper closes after eviction
title_zh: 俄罗斯主要独立报纸在被驱逐后关闭
summary: The outlet has been evicted from its offices of three decades and says it's been blocked from receiving donations.
summary_zh: 该媒体已被从其存在了三十年的办公室中驱逐出来，并表示已被禁止接受捐款。
body_en: Novaya Gazeta, Russia's leading independent newspaper, closes - BBC News
Russia's leading independent newspaper has closed after being evicted from its offices and facing pressure from authorities.
For 30 years, Novaya Gazeta published investigations into corruption, human rights violations and abuse of power in the country.
On Monday, the team behind the newspaper had a final editorial meeting before packing up their belongings and leaving.
The Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Russia's media was highly diverse and that the newspaper's closure was part of "a standard rotational process".
The BBC spoke to its co-founder Dmitry Muratov, a Nobel Peace Prize winner, about the closure.
body_zh: 俄罗斯领先的独立报纸《新报》关闭 - BBC 新闻
俄罗斯领先的独立报纸在被赶出办公室并面临当局压力后已关闭。
30 年来，《新报》发表了对该国腐败、侵犯人权和滥用权力的调查。
周一，该报背后的团队在收拾行李离开之前召开了最后一次编辑会议。
克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，俄罗斯媒体高度多元化，该报的关闭是“标准轮换流程”的一部分。
BBC 与其联合创始人、诺贝尔和平奖获得者德米特里·穆拉托夫 (Dmitry Muratov) 就关闭事宜进行了交谈。

title_en: Trump questions midterm elections integrity after previously accepting results
title_zh: 特朗普在接受结果后质疑中期选举的公正性
summary: Trump made the claims, without evidence, on Truth Social on Monday.
summary_zh: 特朗普周一在没有证据的情况下在“真相社交”节目上做出了上述说法。
body_en: US President Donald Trump has questioned the legitimacy of the midterm election results in which Republicans suffered sweeping losses, days after saying he would accept the outcome.
"Does anybody really believe that this 'Election' was honest. How could the Polls be so wrong?" Trump wrote on Truth Social on Monday.
This appeared to contradict what he told the New York Times on election night that he was "absolutely willing" to accept the results.
Democrats retook both chambers of Congress in last week's elections. State and local officials across the US said voting had been mostly problem-free.
Some key races, including Senate contests in Alaska and Mississippi, have yet to be called.
Trump says US voter fraud is 'rampant' - evidence suggests it is extremely rare

In the Truth Social post, Trump made vague claims about polling, voting "dumps", and "machines" without providing specific evidence of what this referred to and whether he believed there had been error or wrongdoing.
The reporting of vote counts on election night proceeded as normal, according to Charles Stewart III, a political scientist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT).
"We saw across the nation the standard patterns we see in terms of when the votes are reported," he said.
Stewart added that in some states, like Florida and Georgia, some initial reporting of results happens quickly because they already have the results of early and mail ballots.
Trump has previously attempted to cast doubts on the integrity of elections he has lost, although he himself was not on the ballot in the midterms.
"We would have won easily if I was on the ballot," Trump told CBS News, the BBC's US partner, after it was confirmed his party had lost both the Senate and the House.
Surveys ahead of the election from several pollsters and news outlets suggested that Republicans could lose seats in both the House and Senate.

As it stands, Democrats have won 54 US Senate seats and 254 US House seats in the midterms, giving them comfortable majorities in both chambers of Congress even as counting continues in some races, like in Alaska and Mississippi.
"State laws and practicalities are such that some states will just take longer to count," said Ruth Greenwood, director of the Election Law Clinic at Harvard Law School.
"That doesn't mean anything nefarious is occurring—we just need to trust local election officials to count every vote and tell us the results when they are done."
The outcome has been clear since election night. Trump told the New York Times then: "We'll, you know, look forward to working with [Democrats]", adding: "We'll probably work something out."
He has also offered his own analysis of why Republicans lost, acknowledging on Fox News that the Iran war had contributed to the defeat.
"People agree with what I'm doing on Iran but they really probably weren't willing to do the short term consequences of paying more for gasoline - I understand that," he said.

Vice-President JD Vance has also blamed the Iran war, which began in February and which has severely disrupted global oil and gas supplies - causing costs to soar, as the reason their party lost the election.
body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对中期选举结果的合法性提出质疑，共和党在中期选举中遭遇惨败，几天后他表示将接受中期选举结果。
“有人真的相信这次‘选举’是诚实的吗？民意调查怎么会错得这么离谱？”特朗普周一在《Truth Social》上写道。
这似乎与他在选举之夜向《纽约时报》表示的“绝对愿意”接受选举结果的说法相矛盾。
民主党在上周的选举中重新夺回了国会参众两院。美国各地的州和地方官员表示，投票基本上没有问题。
一些关键竞选，包括阿拉斯加和密西西比州的参议院竞选，尚未公布。
特朗普称美国选民欺诈“猖獗”——证据表明这种情况极为罕见
在《真相社会》的帖子中，特朗普对民意调查、投票“垃圾场”和“机器”做出了含糊的说法，但没有提供具体证据来证明这指的是什么以及他是否认为存在错误或不当行为。
麻省理工学院 (MIT) 政治学家查尔斯·斯图尔特三世 (Charles Stewart III) 表示，选举之夜的计票报告正常进行。
他说：“我们在全国范围内看到了投票报告时所看到的标准模式。”
斯图尔特补充说，在佛罗里达州和佐治亚州等一些州，一些初步的结果报告很快就会发生，因为他们已经有了早期和邮寄选票的结果。
特朗普此前曾试图对他输掉的选举的公正性提出质疑，尽管他本人并未参加中期选举。
在确认他的政党失去了参议院和众议院的席位后，特朗普对英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻说：“如果我参加投票，我们就会轻松获胜。”
几家民意调查机构和新闻媒体在选举前进行的调查显示，共和党可能会失去众议院和参议院的席位。
目前，民主党在中期选举中赢得了 54 个美国参议院席位和 254 个美国众议院席位，尽管阿拉斯加州和密西西比州等一些竞选的计票工作仍在继续，但他们在国会参众两院都获得了轻松的多数席位。
哈佛法学院选举法诊所主任露丝·格林伍德表示：“各州的法律和实际情况使得一些州需要更长的时间才能进行统计。”
“这并不意味着发生了任何邪恶的事情——我们只需要相信当地选举官员会清点每一张选票，并在完成后告诉我们结果。”
自选举之夜以来，结果已经很明确了。特朗普当时对《纽约时报》表示：“你知道，我们期待与[民主党]合作”，并补充道：“我们可能会找到一些办法。”
他还对共和党失败的原因进行了自己的分析，并在福克斯新闻上承认伊朗战争是导致失败的原因之一。
“人们同意我在伊朗问题上所做的事情，但他们可能真的不愿意承担为汽油支付更多费用的短期后果——我理解这一点，”他说。
副总统万斯也指责伊朗战争是该党在选举中失败的原因，这场战争从二月份开始，严重扰乱了全球石油和天然气供应，导致成本飙升。

title_en: Nine Zimbabweans caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine
title_zh: 九名津巴布韦人涉嫌试图离开南非前往乌克兰作战而被捕
summary: Hundreds of people from different African countries have been recruited to fight for Russia, according to Ukraine.
summary_zh: 据乌克兰称，来自不同非洲国家的数百人已被招募为俄罗斯而战。
body_en: Russia-Ukraine war: Nine Zimbabweans caught trying to leave South Africa to join conflict - BBC News
By Khanyisile Ngcobo and Nobuhle Simelane , Reporting from Johannesburg
Nine Zimbabweans have been arrested in South Africa after they were caught allegedly trying to leave the country to fight in the war between Russia and the Ukraine, police say.
The group, aged between 20 and 26, were arrested in and around Johannesburg by a multidisciplinary team on Sunday evening.
They were caught as they were "preparing to board flights out of the country", authorities added, but their final destination is unclear.
They have been charged with contravening South Africa's Regulation of Foreign Military Assistance Act, which outlaws mercenary activity without government permission.
Police said five people were arrested at South Africa's biggest airport, OR Tambo, and another four at a hotel in Bruma, east of Johannesburg by a multidisciplinary team that involved Interpol.
All nine later appeared in court, according to state prosecutors.

The police statement added that the involvement of Interpol and other international law enforcement agencies indicated that the suspects had also allegedly violated laws in their respective home countries, prompting cooperation with South African authorities.
They have also not said whether the group allegedly intended to fight for Russia or Ukraine nor provided details of the organisations allegedly involved in facilitating their travel.
Citizens of several African countries, including Kenya, Ghana and South Africa, have gone to fight for Russia in Ukraine - some they had been duped and had not realised where they were going.
A Ukrainian intelligence assessment estimated earlier this year that more than 1,700 people from 36 countries in Africa have been recruited to fight for Russia.
Kenya at the time estimated that 252 citizens had been illegally conscripted in Russia. In March, Foreign Minister Musalia Mudavadi visited Moscow to address the issue.
He said at the time that an agreement had been reached to stop recruiting Kenyan nationals.
In March, Zimbabwe said that 15 of its nationals had been killed after being recruited to fight for Russia in Ukraine, with more than 60 still trapped on the frontlines.
The previous month, South Africa secured the return of 17 South Africans who were allegedly tricked into joining the war.
In December last year, South African authorities arrested five people, including a journalist, for allegedly recruiting people to join the war.
Ukraine has also been recruiting foreign nationals, including from Africa.
Lured by lucrative job offers and sent to fight for Russia - Kenyans want their sons back

body_zh: 俄罗斯-乌克兰战争：九名津巴布韦人试图离开南非参加冲突而被捕 -_澳门赌博平台
Khanyisile Ngcobo 和 Nobuhle Simelane 报道，约翰内斯堡
警方称，九名津巴布韦人因涉嫌试图离开该国参加俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争而在南非被捕。
该团伙年龄在 20 至 26 岁之间，周日晚上在约翰内斯堡及其周边地区被多学科小组逮捕。
当局补充说，他们是在“准备登机出境”时被捕的，但他们的最终目的地尚不清楚。
他们被指控违反南非《外国军事援助管理法》，该法禁止未经政府许可的雇佣军活动。
警方表示，国际刑警组织参与的多学科小组在南非最大的机场奥利弗·坦博机场逮捕了五人，并在约翰内斯堡东部布鲁马的一家酒店逮捕了另外四人。
据州检察官称，所有九人后来均出庭。
警方声明补充说，国际刑警组织和其他国际执法机构的参与表明，嫌疑人据称也违反了各自国家的法律，因此需要与南非当局合作。
他们也没有透露该组织是否据称打算为俄罗斯或乌克兰而战，也没有提供据称参与为他们旅行提供便利的组织的详细信息。
包括肯尼亚、加纳和南非在内的几个非洲国家的公民已经前往乌克兰为俄罗斯而战——其中一些人被欺骗了，并没有意识到自己要去哪里。
乌克兰情报机构今年早些时候的一项评估估计，来自非洲 36 个国家的 1700 多人已被招募为俄罗斯作战。
肯尼亚当时估计有 252 名公民在俄罗斯被非法征召入伍。 3月，外交部长穆萨利亚·穆达瓦迪访问莫斯科解决这一问题。

title_en: At least 39 die after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
title_zh: 前往欧洲的移民船在塞内加尔海域沉没 至少39人死亡
summary: The Atlantic crossing to Spain's Canary Islands remains dangerous for migrants seeking a better life
summary_zh: 对于寻求更好生活的移民来说，穿越大西洋前往西班牙加那利群岛仍然很危险
body_en: By Ondiro Oganga and Madina Maishanu , BBC Africa
At least 39 people have died after a boat carrying migrants sank off the coast of Senegal, the Senegalese Press Agency (APS) reports.
The interior ministry said one person had been rescued, but the number of people still missing was yet to be established.
The small wooden boat capsized between the capital, Dakar and the northern city of Saint-Louis, as it headed towards Spain's Canary Islands.
Spanish migrant rights group Walking Borders recorded 635 deaths on the Atlantic route to the Canary Islands between January and May 2026, the highest toll among the routes it monitors.

Saliou Diouf, founder of Senegalese migrant aid group Boza Fii, told the AFP news agency that all the bodies recovered by Sunday evening were Senegalese. The nationalities of other people on board was yet to be established, as search operations continued.
Four bodies were recovered on Monday morning in an advanced state of decomposition and buried following a collective funeral prayer organised by the fire service.
Rescue teams are searching along a 25km (15-mile)- stretch of coastline, but operations have been complicated by difficult access and strong ocean currents, which are pushing bodies further south.
Authorities say 24 of the 39 victims have been identified and their bodies returned to their families, while 11 others are still awaiting identification.
President Bassirou Diomaye Faye has expressed his condolences to the victims' families and urged Senegalese nationals not to risk their lives on the dangerous sea crossings.
In a statement posted on X, he pledged to intensify efforts to dismantle the networks organising the journeys.
"We will relentlessly continue the fight against those who organise these crossings and the work that gives our young people reasons to hope here," he said.
The tragedy comes amid renewed concerns over the dangers facing migrant attempting to reach Europe by sea.
Walking Borders estimates that about 21 people died for every 100 who reached the Canary Islands during the period it monitored.
Senegalese authorities said they had intercepted another boat, on Friday, carrying 142 migrants attempting to reach Spain.
Those on board included 23 women, two babies and two other children. Police said the group comprised nationals of Senegal, Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, Guinea and Nigeria.
Meanwhile, a state of emergency was declared on the Spanish island of El Hierro on Saturday following a surge in migrant arrivals.
More than 3,300 people have reached the island in about 30 boats since the beginning of November, according to local authorities.
This amounts to almost a third of the population on the island, one of the main entry points into Europe for migrants arriving from West Africa.
Fernando Clavijo, president of the Canary Islands regional government, described the situation as "absolutely unsustainable," reports the Reuters news agency.
body_zh: 作者：Ondiro Oganga 和 Madina Maishanu，BBC 非洲
据塞内加尔通讯社 (APS) 报道，一艘载有移民的船只在塞内加尔海岸沉没，造成至少 39 人死亡。
内政部表示，已有一人获救，但失踪人数尚未确定。
这艘小木船在前往西班牙加那利群岛的途中在首都达喀尔和北部城市圣路易斯之间倾覆。
西班牙移民权利组织“行走边境”记录了 2026 年 1 月至 5 月期间，在通往加那利群岛的大西洋航线上有 635 人死亡，这是其监测的航线中死亡人数最高的。
塞内加尔移民援助组织 Boza Fii 创始人萨利乌·迪乌夫 (Saliou Diouf) 告诉法新社，周日晚间发现的所有尸体都是塞内加尔人。随着搜寻行动仍在继续，船上其他人员的国籍尚未确定。
周一早上，消防部门组织了集体葬礼祈祷后，发现了四具高度腐烂的尸体，并进行了埋葬。
救援队正在沿着 25 公里（15 英里）长的海岸线进行搜索，但由于难以进入，而且强劲的洋流将尸体推向更南的地方，因此行动变得复杂。
当局表示，39 名遇难者中有 24 人的身份已得到确认，他们的遗体已归还给家人，另有 11 人仍在等待身份确认。
总统巴西鲁·迪马耶·法耶向遇难者家属表示哀悼，并敦促塞内加尔国民不要冒着生命危险穿越危险的海上通道。
在 X 上发布的一份声明中，他承诺加大力度拆除组织旅行的网络。
他说：“我们将继续不懈地打击组织这些过境点的人，并继续开展让我们的年轻人有理由在这里充满希望的工作。”
这场悲剧发生之际，人们再次担心试图通过海路到达欧洲的移民面临的危险。
Walking Borders 估计，在其监测期间，每 100 人到达加那利群岛，就有约 21 人死亡。
塞内加尔当局表示，他们于周五拦截了另一艘载有 142 名试图前往西班牙的移民的船只。
机上人员包括 23 名妇女、两名婴儿和另外两名儿童。警方称，该团伙由塞内加尔、冈比亚、几内亚比绍、几内亚和尼日利亚的国民组成。
与此同时，由于移民人数激增，西班牙耶罗岛于周六宣布进入紧急状态。
据地方当局称，自 11 月初以来，已有超过 3,300 人乘坐约 30 艘船抵达该岛。
这相当于岛上人口的近三分之一，是来自西非的移民进入欧洲的主要入境点之一。
据路透社报道，加那利群岛地区政府主席费尔南多·克拉维霍称这种情况“绝对不可持续”。

title_en: Judge denies motion to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case
title_zh: 法官驳回驳回林赛·克兰西谋杀案的动议
summary: The ruling means the case can move forward, possibly with reduced charges in a new trial.
summary_zh: 该裁决意味着案件可以继续推进，新审判中的指控可能会减少。
body_en: A Massachusetts judge has denied a motion to dismiss the murder case against Lindsay Clancy, the US woman accused of killing her three children.
The judge's ruling follows her defence team's request to dismiss the case after the 12-person jury in her September trial failed to reach a verdict.
Clancy has not denied killing her children in 2023, but her defence team argues she was suffering from severe postpartum psychosis at the time. Prosecutors say the killings were intentional.
The ruling clears the way for prosecutors to pursue the case. They could reduce the charges in a potential second trial or dismiss them altogether.
Clancy's defence team argued to dismiss the case against her due to double jeopardy - a legal standard that prevents a person from being tried for the same crime twice.

Her lawyers argued that Judge William Sullivan, who presided over the 26-day jury trial last summer, acted prematurely when he declared a mistrial on 4 September, saying that he should have sought a viable alternative.
The five-week trial, its lead-up and aftermath gripped Americans, and put postpartum mental health issues such as psychosis in the spotlight.
In his ruling on Monday, Sullivan said that a retrial would not unconstitutionally subject Clancy to double jeopardy, according to court documents obtained by the BBC.
The possibility that "an unreasonably stubborn or eccentric juror" could be seated is "an unavoidable risk of the jury system", he said.

"Because the court concludes that there was manifest necessity for a mistrial based on the jury's deadlock, a retrial on the murder indictments does not violate Clancy's right not to be placed in double jeopardy."
Sullivan also denied a defence motion to see records of the lone holdout juror in the case and to question the juror under oath.
He said the defence failed to demonstrate that the records were needed for Clancy's defence at any retrial, and that questioning the juror "would have been impermissibly coercive".
The judge has marked 16 November to discuss scheduling a potential second trial. He previously suggested it could begin in March.
The BBC has contacted Clancy's lawyers for comment.
Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband says he forgave her so he would not be 'eaten up inside forever'
Lindsay Clancy's trial puts postpartum psychosis in the spotlight

Prosecutors in the closely watched case alleged that on 24 January 2023, Clancy intentionally strangled all of her children - Cora, 5, Dawson, 3, and Callan, eight months - in their Duxbury, Massachusetts, home.
After weeks of emotional testimony, the jury took a week to deliberate, repeatedly telling the judge that they could not reach a verdict.
The deadlocked stemmed from a lone juror who voted to convict Clancy of first-degree murder, while the 11 other jurors intended to acquit Clancy by reason of insanity.
In Massachusetts, as well as in all US criminal murder trials, juries must reach a unanimous decision to convict or acquit a defendant.
body_zh: 马萨诸塞州一名法官驳回了驳回针对林赛·克兰西谋杀案的动议，林赛·克兰西是被指控杀害其三个孩子的美国妇女。
法官做出这一裁决之前，她的辩护团队在 12 人陪审团在 9 ​​月份的审判中未能达成裁决后，请求驳回此案。
克兰西并未否认在 2023 年杀害了她的孩子，但她的辩护团队称她当时患有严重的产后精神病。检察官称，这些杀人事件是故意的。
该裁决为检察官追查此案扫清了道路。他们可以在可能的第二次审判中减少指控或完全驳回指控。
克兰西的辩护团队以双重危险为由驳回对她的诉讼——这是一项法律标准，可以防止一个人因同一罪行两次受审。
她的律师辩称，去年夏天主持了为期 26 天陪审团审判的威廉·沙利文法官在 9 月 4 日宣布审判无效时采取了过早的行动，并表示他应该寻求可行的替代方案。
为期五周的试验及其前期和后续影响吸引了美国人，并使精神病等产后心理健康问题成为人们关注的焦点。
根据英国广播公司获得的法庭文件，沙利文在周一的裁决中表示，重审不会违宪地使克兰西面临双重危险。
他说，“陪审员制度中不可避免的风险”是“一个不合理的顽固或古怪的陪审员”的可能性。
“由于法院根据陪审团的僵局得出结论，显然有必要进行误审，因此对谋杀起诉书进行重审并不侵犯克兰西不陷入双重危险的权利。”
沙利文还拒绝了辩方提出的要求查看该案中唯一坚持不懈的陪审员记录并在宣誓下质询该陪审员的动议。
他表示，辩方未能证明克兰西在任何重审中的辩护都需要这些记录，并且质疑陪审员“将是不允许的胁迫行为”。
法官已于 11 月 16 日讨论安排可能的二审。他此前建议可能从三月份开始。
BBC 已联系克兰西的律师征求意见。
林赛·克兰西的前夫表示，他原谅了她，这样他就不会“永远被吞噬”
林赛·克兰西的审判使产后精神病成为人们关注的焦点
密切关注的案件中的检察官声称，2023 年 1 月 24 日，克兰西在马萨诸塞州达克斯伯里的家中故意勒死了她所有的孩子——5 岁的科拉、3 岁的道森和 8 个月大的卡兰。
经过数周的情感证词后，陪审团花了一周的时间进行商议，反复告诉法官他们无法做出裁决。
僵局源于一名陪审员投票判定克兰西犯有一级谋杀罪，而其他 11 名陪审员则打算以精神错乱为由宣判克兰西无罪。
在马萨诸塞州以及美国所有刑事谋杀案审判中，陪审团必须一致决定对被告定罪或无罪。

title_en: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
title_zh: 特朗普称联邦调查局正在调查英伟达老板与中国间谍的恋情
summary: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.
summary_zh: 美国总统表示，他周一与黄仁勋进行了交谈，并向他询问了与被指控的间谍的风流韵事。
body_en: Donald Trump has said the FBI is investigating the affair between the boss of Nvidia and an alleged Chinese spy.
The US President said he spoke with chief executive Jensen Huang on Monday following reports that the US believed he had been targeted in a Chinese espionage campaign.
"I asked him that question, 'Did you have any idea she was a spy?' He said 'I had no idea she was a spy' and I really believe him," Trump told reporters.
China has rejected claims that Huang was targeted, with its foreign ministry saying the allegations were "entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China".

Nvidia, who has commissioned an independent investigation into the affair involving Alice Huang, alleged to be a Chinese spy, said it had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised.
But later on Monday, Trump said the FBI was now looking into the issue, but did not elaborate on the probe or when it was launched. The BBC has contacted the FBI.
US intelligence officials believe Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report.
The report said Secretary of State Marco Rubio sent a memo to top officials in Washington last spring warning that the Nvidia boss was in a close relationship with a Chinese spy.
Alice Huang was managing director of Singaporean company Megaspeed, which has had dealings with Nvidia, the company at the centre at the development of AI worldwide through its microchips.

The American firm run, co-founded by Huang, is also a major focus in the AI rivalry between the US and China, with officials treating the company's exports to Beijing as a matter of national security.
Trump, at a Monday afternoon news conference, said he thought Huang was an "honorable guy and I feel very confident that he will be in good shape".

"I did speak to him today just to see if he's feeling alright, how you doing, and I asked him about that and he said he absolutely had no idea that the person in question was a spy," the president said.
Trump added he was "sure" China president Xi Jinping would "ask me about it" when they next met.
Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond
Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
Huang has admitted he was "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children.
He said on Monday he was "committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security" and would cooperate with the investigation the company had launched.
Huang has also been requested to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees next week.

In the letter, the chairmen of the committees said they were seeking a briefing "on Nvidia's security protocols against foreign adversary espionage and your interactions with a publicly reported People's Republic of China (PRC) intelligence asset: Megaspeed executive Alice Huang".
body_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，联邦调查局正在调查英伟达老板与一名涉嫌中国间谍之间的事件。
美国总统表示，在有报道称美国认为他成为中国间谍活动的目标后，他周一与首席执行官黄仁勋进行了交谈。
“我问他这个问题，‘你知道她是间谍吗？’他说‘我不知道她是间谍’，我真的相信他，”特朗普告诉记者。
中国否认了黄蜂成为攻击目标的说法，中国外交部表示，这些指控“完全毫无根据，纯属猜测，旨在抹黑和中伤中国”。
英伟达已委托对涉嫌中国间谍的黄爱丽丝事件进行独立调查，并表示没有理由相信该公司的机密或国家安全受到损害。
但周一晚些时候，特朗普表示联邦调查局正在调查这一问题，但没有详细说明调查或何时启动。 BBC 已联系 FBI。
据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为爱丽丝·黄（又名黄乐）是北京的间谍。
报道称，国务卿马可·卢比奥去年春天向华盛顿高级官员发送了一份备忘录，警告英伟达老板与一名中国间谍关系密切。
Alice Huang 是新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的董事总经理，该公司与英伟达有业务往来，英伟达是通过其微芯片在全球人工智能开发中处于中心地位的公司。
这家由黄仁勋共同创立的美国公司也是中美人工智能竞争的一个主要焦点，官员们将该公司对北京的出口视为国家安全问题。
特朗普在周一下午的新闻发布会上表示，他认为黄是一个“值得尊敬的人，我对他的健康状况非常有信心”。
总统说：“我今天确实和他谈过，只是想看看他是否感觉还好，你过得怎么样，我问了他这个问题，他说他绝对不知道这个人是间谍。”
特朗普补充说，他“确信”中国国家主席习近平下次会面时会“问我此事”。

英伟达股价因黄与涉嫌中国间谍的恋情调查而暴跌
到目前为止，我们对黄仁勋与中国间谍嫌疑人的恋情了解多少
黄承认他对妻子“不忠”，并为伤害她和他们的孩子而道歉。
他周一表示，他“致力于保护英伟达并支持美国的国家安全”，并将配合该公司发起的调查。
黄还被要求出席下周几个国会委员会举行的联合闭门简报会。
在信中，这些委员会的主席表示，他们正在寻求“关于英伟达针对外国对手间谍活动的安全协议以及您与公开报道的中华人民共和国（PRC）情报资产：Megaspeed 高管爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的互动”的简报。

title_en: Trump says war on Iran ‘effectively over’ after talks with Qatar’s PM
title_zh: 特朗普在与卡塔尔总理会谈后表示对伊朗的战争“有效结束”
summary: Iranian officials dismissed Trump's latest remarks as 'fake news' after the US president suggested an end to the war.
summary_zh: 在美国总统建议结束战争后，伊朗官员将特朗普的最新言论斥为“假新闻”。
body_en: Share Trump says war on Iran ‘effectively over’ after talks with Qatar’s PM on social media

United States President Donald Trump has signalled that he considers the US-Israel war on Iran “effectively” at an end, after meeting with Qatar’s Prime Minister Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani in Washington, DC.
In a surprise briefing on Monday, Trump told reporters efforts to end the conflict were gaining momentum and that further military action may not be needed.

“At this point, taking military action doesn’t seem to be a very necessary thing, but we’re locked and loaded, ready to go for any reason that changes,” he said. “Israel and the entire Middle East are protected from Iranian danger and threats, and we’re seeing momentum toward the end of this conflict. I think it’s going to be ending fairly soon.”

Trump’s comments come shortly after he and Vice President JD Vance hosted Sheikh Mohammed at the White House to discuss the Iran war. In a post on X following Trump’s remarks, the Qatari prime minister said he had “discussed the situation in the region and ways to progress the US-Iran talks” during the White House meeting.
He added, “Grateful for the positive discussions on reaching a deal and bringing peace to the region.”

Trump, in his press briefing, said “much was discussed” with respect to Iran and claimed again that the US had destroyed the Iranian military. He said the conflict, “militarily, is effectively over”, but that “we’re just keeping it the status quo”.

The “status quo” would involve continuing the US naval blockade against Iranian ports, he said, as well as the newly announced Task Force Iron Gate, which seeks to cut off trade by land and through the Caspian Sea.

“Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait and others would prefer the status quo, that we remain as is,” he said. “In other words, a continuation of the greatest naval blockade in the history of our country. Probably in the history of the world.”
Trump also declined to commit to any long-term ceasefire, saying “I don’t guarantee anything.”
Iranian officials, meanwhile, dismissed Trump’s latest remarks as a distraction.

“The war on Iran has already wrecked the US government. But Washington flails like a desperate gambler,” Iran’s Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei wrote in a post on social media.
“FOLD YOUR HAND. STOP manufacturing FAKE NEWS about imaginary talks.”
Separately, Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian said that the country’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei had called for an end to the situation, which he described as “neither war nor peace”.
Pezeshkian added that Iran was open to further negotiations but would not be coerced, according to Iranian media. “We will not surrender to force and bullying,” he said.
Since the war on Iran began on February 28 , the conflict has spilled into surrounding countries and roiled international trade.

Almost as soon as the US and Israel began their attacks, Iran moved to shut down the Strait of Hormuz, a vital waterway for oil, gas and fertiliser, among other goods. Iran also responded to US and Israeli strikes with missile and drone fire on its neighbours in the Gulf, including Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait and the UAE, with many of the attacks targeting US military installations.

body_en: Hungarian police reportedly detain brother of ex-PM Viktor Orban | Corruption News | Al Jazeera
Share Hungarian police reportedly detain brother of ex-PM Viktor Orban on social media
Former Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban has accused the country’s new government of “political persecution” after the reported arrest of his younger brother.

Hungarian police arrested Aron Orban on Monday on suspicion of people smuggling, among other offences, according to a press report shared by Prime Minister Peter Magyar. Viktor Orban’s staunch opposition to immigration defined his 16 years in power that ended in defeat at elections in April.

News of the arrest was first reported by Kontroll, a news site owned by Magyar’s brother, Marton. Police carried out raids involving Aron Orban’s business associates but did not confirm whether he was among those detained, local media reported.
Viktor Orban accused the government of arresting his brother as a way to “divert attention” from other issues.
“I am the real target. My younger brother is simply being used to get to me,” he wrote on X.
Like other members of the Orban family, Aron built several successful businesses during his brother’s rule.
Last year, an investigation by news site Telex linked Aron Orban and his business associates to an alleged scheme involving visas for foreign guest workers.
Authorities said they had detained four people suspected of people smuggling.

Pro-EU conservative Magyar won a landslide election victory in April, ending 16 years of Orban’s rule, after promising to investigate his predecessor’s alleged corruption and abuse of power while in office.

Saudi Arabia’s critical East-West oil pipeline has suffered another attack, according to state media.

An official at the Saudi Ministry of Energy said that the pipeline was targeted in the Medina region in the west of the country on Monday, causing a “limited fire” that was extinguished, the Saudi Press Agency reported.

The report did not identify the party behind the attack, but fighting continues to intensify between Saudi Arabia and the Yemeni government coalition that it backs, and the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen.

The pipeline is essential for bypassing the Strait of Hormuz, which remains tightly constricted by the US-Israel war on Iran. It has come under attack several times as the war on Iran fuels a global energy crisis .

title_en: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth
title_zh: 共和党国会议员将强制对国防部长赫格塞斯进行弹劾投票
summary: The effort will likely fail, but Representative Thomas Massie wants to push Trump to fire Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process.
summary_zh: 这一努力可能会失败，但众议员托马斯·马西希望在民主党发起自己的弹劾计划之前推动特朗普解雇赫格塞斯。
body_en: A Republican congressman plans to force a vote in the House of Representatives this week to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, alleging he has violated the US Constitution.
"By engaging in hostilities in Iran for more than 90 days without congressional authorization, Secretary Hegseth is breaking the law and must be held accountable," Representative Thomas Massie said.

The effort will likely fail, given Republicans will remain in power in Congress until January. But Massie says he wants to push President Donald Trump to fire Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process.
Hegseth, who will hold a news conference on Tuesday about Massie's move, said he was not concerned.
Massie formally introduced the articles of impeachment in a resolution on the House floor on Monday afternoon.
"I'm doing this because it's the right thing to do," he told reporters after introducing the articles.
When asked by reporters about the impending resolution earlier on Monday, Hegseth said: "We're not worried about that."
He added he would hold a news conference Tuesday morning "on that very topic". Hegseth's last news conference was in May.

Massie, who lost re-election earlier this year, has been critical of Trump and the war in Iran since it started nearly nine months ago. He is known for also pushing the administration to release federal files on the deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

The Kentucky congressman first introduced impeachment articles in September and has now brought them back in the wake of Republicans losing control of both the House and Senate in last week's midterm elections. He has said his push to rid the administration of Hegseth is meant to prevent a Democrat spectacle next year.

"My effort to impeach Secretary Hegseth is a much gentler version of what's coming when the Democrats assume control of the House and Senate next year," Massie also said in a statement. "They will hold hearings and trials."
"President Trump should replace Secretary Hegseth now while he can still get a replacement confirmed in the Senate," he also said.

Impeaching a cabinet secretary is rare. The impeachment must be approved by both chambers for the secretary to be removed from office. As with the presidential process, the House would first hold a vote on charges against Hegseth and the Senate then would conduct a trial to decide whether to acquit or convict.
The House has voted to impeach only two cabinet members in US history, but the Senate did not convict either one.

While impeachment has been "an incredibly rare process", it has become far more common since the House impeached President Bill Clinton in 1998, said Paul Gowder, a law professor at Northwestern University in Chicago. Trump was impeached by the House twice.
"Impeachment has become much more common as the country has become more politically polarised," he said, predicting several more of Trump's cabinet members may face impeachment.

Now Massie has introduced his resolution, Speaker of the House Mike Johnson must schedule a time to consider it within two days. Lawmakers could vote on the resolution directly, or vote to refer it to committee or to set it aside.

Massie will likely have the support of House Democrats, with that party's leader, Hakeem Jeffries, saying on Sunday that he is a "hard yes" on impeachment, but may not be able to bring Republicans to his side.
Massie told reporters he was not sure if the measure had sufficient backing to pass.
Peter Loge, a professor of public affairs at George Washington University, told the BBC that the impeachment measure is "likely to pass the House because the Republican majority is so slim".
body_zh: 一名共和党国会议员计划本周在众议院强制投票弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格斯，指控他违反了美国宪法。
众议员托马斯·马西表示：“赫格塞斯部长在未经国会授权的情况下在伊朗进行了超过 90 天的敌对行动，这违反了法律，必须承担责任。”
鉴于共和党将在国会继续掌权直到明年一月，这一努力可能会失败。但马西表示，他希望在民主党启动自己的弹劾程序之前推动唐纳德·特朗普总统解雇赫格塞斯。
赫格斯将于周二就马西的举动举行新闻发布会，他表示他并不担心。
马西周一下午在众议院决议中正式提出了弹劾条款。
“我这样做是因为这是正确的做法，”他在介绍这些文章后告诉记者。
周一早些时候，当记者问及即将出台的决议时，赫格斯表示：“我们对此并不担心。”
他补充说，他将在周二上午“就这个话题”举行新闻发布会。赫格斯的最后一次新闻发布会是在五月份。
今年早些时候失去连任的马西自近九个月前开始以来一直对特朗普和伊朗战争持批评态度。他还因推动政府公布已故性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的联邦文件而闻名。
这位肯塔基州国会议员于 9 月份首次提出弹劾条款，在共和党在上周的中期选举中失去众议院和参议院的控制权后，现在又重新提出了弹劾条款。他曾表示，他推动摆脱赫格塞斯政府的目的是为了防止明年出现民主党的大场面。
马西还在一份声明中表示：“我弹劾赫格斯国务卿的努力，与民主党明年控制参众两院时的情况相比，是一个温和得多的版本。” “他们将举行听证会和审判。”
他还表示：“特朗普总统现在应该更换国务卿赫格塞斯，同时他仍然可以在参议院确认继任者。”
弹劾内阁秘书的情况很少见。弹劾必须得到参众两院的批准，国务卿才能被免职。与总统程序一样，众议院首先对赫格塞斯的指控进行投票，然后参议院进行审判，决定是否无罪或有罪。
美国历史上众议院仅投票弹劾了两名内阁成员，但参议院并未对其中任何一人定罪。
芝加哥西北大学法学教授保罗·高德 (Paul Gowder) 表示，虽然弹劾是“极其罕见的过程”，但自 1998 年众议院弹劾总统比尔·克林顿以来，弹劾变得更加普遍。特朗普曾两次被众议院弹劾。
他说：“随着国家政治两极分化加剧，弹劾变得更加普遍。”他预测特朗普的几名内阁成员可能会面临弹劾。
现在马西已经提出了他的决议，众议院议长迈克·约翰逊必须在两天内安排时间进行考虑。立法者可以直接对该决议进行投票，也可以投票将其提交给委员会或将其搁置。
马西可能会得到众议院民主党人的支持，该党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯周日表示，他在弹劾问题上“强硬同意”，但可能无法让共和党人站在他一边。
马西告诉记者，他不确定这项措施是否有足够的支持来通过。
乔治华盛顿大学公共事务教授彼得·洛格告诉英国广播公司，弹劾措施“很可能在众议院获得通过，因为共和党的多数席位太少了”。

title_en: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
title_zh: 土耳其钢铁厂爆炸造成至少17人死亡
summary: Eyewitnesses say the explosion shook the ground, with one believing an earthquake had hit near the Habas Demir Celik plant in Aliaga.
summary_zh: 目击者称，爆炸震动了地面，有人认为阿利亚加的 Habas Demir Celik 工厂附近发生了地震。
body_en: At least 17 people have died and 12 others have been injured in an explosion at an iron and steel factory near the port city of Izmir in western Turkey.

All those killed and injured were workers at the Habas Demir Celik plant in Aliaga, one of the country's leading steel producers, authorities said. Footage from the scene showed a large fire inside the facility and a towering column of smoke rising into the air.
The local governor said the blast happened around midday after a crane carrying a replacement boiler collapsed, causing materials to fall into a furnace below.
Workplace accidents remain a chronic problem in Turkey, the Turkish Health and Safety Labor Watch, an independent civil society organisation, said.

President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan originally said the death toll was 16, but the Health Minister, Kemal Memişoğlu, later announced that one of those who had been critically injured had later died, taking the toll to 17.
Eyewitnesses at the scene said the explosion shook the ground, with one person initially believing an earthquake had struck.
In a statement, the company that runs the factory said the accident occurred during scheduled maintenance work on one of the plant's electric arc furnaces.
Izmir Governor Süleyman Elban told media that some people were believed to still be under the rubble.
Speaking after a cabinet meeting on Monday, Erdoğan confirmed the deaths and said investigations were under way, while search and rescue operations continued.
At least five people have been arrested, according BBC News's Turkish service, citing local media reports.
The Habas plant is in the Izmir district of Aliaga which is a major port and one of Turkey's main shipbreaking hubs.

body_zh: 土耳其西部港口城市伊兹密尔附近一家钢铁厂发生爆炸，造成至少 17 人死亡、12 人受伤。
当局称，所有死伤者都是阿利亚加哈巴斯德米尔塞利克工厂的工人，该工厂是该国主要钢铁生产商之一。现场视频显示，设施内发生大火，一股高耸的浓烟升到空中。
当地州长表示，爆炸发生在中午左右，当时一台装载替换锅炉的起重机倒塌，导致材料落入下面的熔炉中。
独立民间社会组织土耳其健康与安全劳工观察表示，工作场所事故仍然是土耳其的一个长期问题。
总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安最初称死亡人数为 16 人，但卫生部长凯末尔·梅米什奥卢后来宣布，其中一名重伤者随后死亡，使死亡人数达到 17 人。
现场目击者称，爆炸震动了地面，一名目击者最初认为发生了地震。
运营该工厂的公司在一份声明中表示，事故发生在工厂一台电弧炉的定期维护工作期间。
伊兹密尔州长苏莱曼·埃尔班告诉媒体，据信一些人仍在废墟下。
埃尔多安在周一的内阁会议后发表讲话，证实了死亡事件，并表示调查正在进行中，同时搜救行动仍在继续。
据英国广播公司土耳其新闻部援引当地媒体报道，至少有五人被捕。
哈巴斯工厂位于阿利亚加的伊兹密尔区，该地区是一个主要港口，也是土耳其主要拆船中心之一。
当地媒体报道，土耳其卡帕多西亚岩石崩塌造成两人死亡
州长称，伊斯坦布尔遭遇84年来最强降雨，造成两人死亡

title_en: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
title_zh: 法国指责伊朗超市冰箱遭黑客攻击
summary: Tons of chilled and frozen food was spoiled last month as fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets heated up.
summary_zh: 上个月，数百家超市的冰箱和冰柜温度升高，大量冷藏和冷冻食品变质。
body_en: By Ella Kipling and Joe Tidy , Cyber Correspondent, BBC World Service
France has accused Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) of being behind cyber-attacks that raised the temperatures of supermarket fridges and freezers across the country last month.
Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said the attack was "unprecedented in both its scale and its level of aggression", adding those who were responsible would be hit with sanctions.
Iran has yet to respond officially, but some Iranian media outlets have dismissed the allegations as baseless.

The French hacking, which led to the destruction of tons of frozen and chilled food in France was followed by a similar attack against supermarkets across several other European countries. It is not known if the instances are linked.

Barrot said the attack on France's supermarkets "marks the first large-scale cyber-attack aimed at sabotage on our national territory, and it constitutes a major attack on the nation's interests and the security of the French people".
He said the government had summoned the Iranian ambassador to Paris to "lodge a very strong protest against this extremely grave act".
France will take "any other necessary and proportionate measures" to respond to the incident and "deter anyone who might seek to repeat it", Barrot added.
The Paris prosecutor said an investigation had been opened into the head of an offensive cyber unit associated with the IRGC as well as his two deputies.
Laure Beccuau named the unit as Shahid Kaveh, which she said had an affiliation with the electronic and cyber centre of the IRGC.
Shahid Kaveh is the name given to a cluster of hackers thought to be directly employed by the Iranian regime.

In recent weeks, a number of commentators and politicians in Iran have argued that the country should extend any retaliation beyond the Middle East if the US and Israel resume the war they started earlier this year.
If the IRGC carried out the cyber-attacks, it remains unclear whether they were part of Iran's deterrence strategy.
On 11 October, hackers gained control of the software that regulates the temperatures of the refrigeration units used in many of France's supermarkets.

More than 100 of Coopérative U's supermarkets were hit, as well as 180 stores from Intermarché and its Netto brand. In some stores, temperatures of the fridges reportedly rose to 50C (120F) overnight.
Other major food retailers including Carrefour, Monoprix and E.Leclerc were also hit by the attack, which targeted software provided by Danish engineering firm Danfoss.
The software allows retailers to manage their cold units remotely.
Earlier this month a second wave of hacks took place, hitting more than 100 stores across Europe.
Supermarkets in Belgium and Luxembourg were affected, while a smaller number of shops were hit in countries including Sweden, Ireland, the Netherlands, Estonia and Finland.

Separately in August a small number of US military bases had fridges mysteriously malfunction, spoiling food. This incident is also being investigated as deliberate cyber-attacks, Reuters news agency has reported, citing sources familiar with the matter.
body_zh: 作者：Ella Kipling 和 Joe Tidy，BBC World Service 网络记者
法国指责伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）是上个月网络攻击的幕后黑手，导致该国超市冰箱和冰柜的温度升高。
外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗表示，这次袭击“无论是规模还是侵略程度都是史无前例的”，并补充说，责任人将受到制裁。
伊朗尚未正式回应，但一些伊朗媒体驳斥了这些指控，称其毫无根据。
法国黑客事件导致法国大量冷冻和冷藏食品被毁，随后其他几个欧洲国家的超市也遭受了类似的攻击。目前尚不清楚这些实例是否有关联。
巴罗表示，针对法国超市的攻击“标志着首次针对我国领土进行破坏的大规模网络攻击，构成对国家利益和法国人民安全的重大攻击”。
他说，政府已召见伊朗驻巴黎大使，“对这一极其严重的行为提出非常强烈的抗议”。
巴罗补充说，法国将采取“任何其他必要和相称的措施”来应对这一事件，并“阻止任何可能试图重蹈覆辙的人”。
巴黎检察官表示，已对与伊斯兰革命卫队有关的一个进攻性网络部队的负责人及其两名副手展开调查。
劳尔·贝库奥将该单位命名为 Shahid Kaveh，她说该单位与伊斯兰革命卫队的电子和网络中心有联系。
Shahid Kaveh 是一群被认为直接受伊朗政权雇佣的黑客的名字。
最近几周，伊朗的一些评论家和政界人士认为，如果美国和以色列恢复今年早些时候发动的战争，伊朗应该将报复行动扩大到中东以外的地区。
如果伊斯兰革命卫队实施了网络攻击，目前尚不清楚它们是否是伊朗威慑战略的一部分。
10 月 11 日，黑客控制了法国许多超市使用的调节制冷装置温度的软件。
Coopérative U 旗下 100 多家超市以及 Intermarché 及其 Netto 品牌的 180 家商店受到袭击。据报道，一些商店的冰箱温度一夜之间升至 50 摄氏度（120 华氏度）。
家乐福、Monoprix 和 E.Leclerc 等其他主要食品零售商也受到此次攻击的打击，攻击目标是丹麦工程公司丹佛斯提供的软件。
该软件允许零售商远程管理他们的冷装置。
本月早些时候，发生了第二波黑客攻击，袭击了欧洲 100 多家商店。
比利时和卢森堡的超市受到影响，瑞典、爱尔兰、荷兰、爱沙尼亚和芬兰等国的少数商店受到影响。
另外，8月份，少数美国军事基地的冰箱神秘地发生故障，导致食物变质。路透社援引知情人士的话报道称，该事件也正在作为蓄意网络攻击进行调查。

title_en: Paris prosecutor opens probe into IRGC cyber unit Shahid Kaveh over fridge cyberattacks
title_zh: 巴黎检察官就冰箱网络攻击对 IRGC 网络部门 Shahid Kaveh 展开调查
summary: The Paris prosecutor said she had opened an investigation into Shahid Kaveh, a shadowy cyber unit of the IRGC, the Islamic republic's ideological army, over the 'unprecedented' cyberattacks targeting French supermarkets' fridges in October. Little is known abo
summary_zh: 巴黎检察官表示，她已对沙希德·卡维 (Shahid Kaveh) 展开调查，沙希德·卡维 (Shahid Kaveh) 是伊斯兰共和国意识形态军队 IRGC 的一个秘密网络单位。
body_en: The Paris prosecutor said she had opened an investigation into Shahid Kaveh, a shadowy cyber unit of the IRGC, the Islamic republic's ideological army, over the 'unprecedented' cyberattacks targeting French supermarkets' fridges in October. Little is known about the Shahid Kaveh unit, although analysts have long observed that the IRGC, which has a vast network of operations, had actively branched out into cyber warfare in recent years. FRANCE 24's Reza Sayah reports from Tehran.
body_zh: 巴黎检察官表示，她已针对 10 月份针对法国超市冰箱的“前所未有”的网络攻击，对伊斯兰共和国意识形态军队 IRGC 的一个秘密网络单位 Shahid Kaveh 展开调查。人们对沙希德·卡维（Shahid Kaveh）部队知之甚少，尽管分析人士长期以来观察到，拥有庞大行动网络的伊斯兰革命卫队近年来已积极涉足网络战。 FRANCE 24 的 Reza Sayah 从德黑兰报道。

title_en: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
title_zh: 英伟达股价因黄与涉嫌中国间谍的恋情调查而暴跌
summary: The share price dropped wiped hundreds of billions of dollars from the value of Nvidia.
summary_zh: 股价下跌使英伟达的价值蒸发了数千亿美元。
body_en: Hundreds of billions of dollars have been wiped off the value of Nvidia after the US chipmaker announced an independent investigation would be carried out into its chief executive's affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
The tech firm saw its shares fall by about 4% by close of trade on Monday after Jensen Huang admitted having an extramarital affair.
Nvidia's probe came after reports that the US believed the Nvidia boss had been targeted in an espionage campaign by China.
However, China has rejected the claims, with its foreign ministry saying allegations about Chinese spies were "entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China".

Nvidia said it had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised, but a statement by the firm's board of directors said it would begin an investigation in "light of recent reporting that founder and chief executive Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort".
US intelligence officials believe Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report , external .
The report said Secretary of State Marco Rubio sent a memo to top officials in Washington last spring warning that the Nvidia boss was in a close relationship with a Chinese spy.
Alice Huang was managing director of Singaporean company Megaspeed, which has had dealings with Nvidia.

Jensen Huang admitted he was "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. He added he was "committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security" and would cooperate with the investigation.
The Nvidia co-founder has also been requested to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees next week.

Members of the US House Foreign Affairs Committee last week asked Jensen Huang to appear for a closed-door briefing on his interactions with Alice Huang, as well as Nvidia's security protocols around espionage.

"Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC's [China's] access to sensitive US technology and information," congressmen Brian Mast, John Moolenaar, and Rick Crawford wrote in a letter.
"It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which US national security has been placed at risk."
After Nvidia's investigation was announced, other big tech bosses, including Elon Musk, came out in support of Jensen Huang to continue leading the firm.
US President Donald Trump said the Nvidia boss was an "honourable guy".
However, the news sparked a sell-off in Nvidia's shares, with about $250bn (£190bn) wiped of the company's market value.
While Nvidia shares fell, the US stock market opened the week on a positive note after last week's turmoil, with Nvidia's rival chipmakers benefiting.

But analysts suggested the hit to the company would be short-lived. Victoria Fernandez, chief market strategist at Crossmark Global Investments said investors would not abandon Nvidia, because the chipmaker was so important to the AI industry.
"Nvidia is the core of this AI trade, and without them, all these other pieces start to fall apart because the financing's not there," she told the BBC.
Jensen Huang co-founded Nvidia, which is central to making the hardware for emerging AI technologies, with two other engineers in 1993.
body_zh: 美国芯片制造商英伟达宣布将对其首席执行官与一名涉嫌中国间谍的恋情进行独立调查后，该公司的价值已蒸发数千亿美元。
在黄仁勋承认婚外情后，该科技公司股价周一收盘下跌约 4%。
英伟达发起调查之前有报道称，美国认为英伟达老板已成为中国间谍活动的目标。
然而，中国否认了这些说法，中国外交部表示，有关中国间谍的指控“完全毫无根据，纯属猜测，意在抹黑和诽谤中国”。
英伟达表示，没有理由相信该公司的机密或国家安全受到损害，但该公司董事会的一份声明表示，“鉴于最近有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋已成为外国情报工作的目标”，该公司将开始调查。
据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为爱丽丝·黄（又名黄乐）是北京的间谍。
报道称，国务卿马可·卢比奥去年春天向华盛顿高级官员发送了一份备忘录，警告英伟达老板与一名中国间谍关系密切。
Alice Huang 是新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的董事总经理，该公司与 Nvidia 有业务往来。
黄仁勋承认他对妻子“不忠”，并为伤害她和孩子而道歉。他补充说，他“致力于保护英伟达并支持美国的国家安全”，并将配合调查。
这位英伟达联合创始人还被要求出席下周几个国会委员会举行的联合闭门简报会。
美国众议院外交事务委员会成员上周要求黄仁勋出席闭门简报会，介绍他与黄爱丽的互动，以及英伟达围绕间谍活动的安全协议。
国会议员布莱恩·马斯特（Brian Mast）、约翰·穆勒纳尔（John Moolenaar）和里克·克劳福德（Rick Crawford）在一封信中写道：“最近的报告引发了有关中华人民共和国获取美国敏感技术和信息的重大国家安全担忧。”
共和党人约翰·莫勒纳尔、布莱恩·马斯特和里克·克劳福德在一份声明中表示：“国会确定美国国家安全面临风险的程度至关重要。”
英伟达的调查宣布后，包括埃隆·马斯克在内的其他大型科技巨头纷纷站出来支持黄仁勋继续领导该公司。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，英伟达的老板是一个“值得尊敬的人”。
然而，这一消息引发了英伟达股票的抛售，该公司市值蒸发约 2500 亿美元（1900 亿英镑）。
尽管英伟达股价下跌，但美国股市在上周的动荡之后，本周开盘上涨，英伟达的竞争对手芯片制造商受益。
但分析师表示，对该公司的打击将是短暂的。 Crossmark Global Investments 首席市场策略师 Victoria Fernandez 表示，投资者不会放弃英伟达，因为这家芯片制造商对人工智能行业非常重要。
她告诉 BBC：“英伟达是人工智能行业的核心，如果没有他们，所有其他部分都会开始分崩离析，因为融资不存在。”
1993 年，黄仁勋与另外两名工程师共同创立了 Nvidia，该公司是新兴人工智能技术硬件制造的核心。

title_en: Russia: Independent Novaya Gazeta shuts its Moscow newsroom
title_zh: 俄罗斯：《独立新报》关闭莫斯科新闻编辑室
summary: The investigative newspaper is closing its doors after Russian authorities labeled it a "foreign agent" and ordered it vacate its Moscow premises.
summary_zh: 在俄罗斯当局将其称为“外国代理人”并命令其搬出莫斯科办事处后，这家调查报纸即将关门。
body_en: The Novaya Gazeta newspaper closed its Moscow office on Monday, saying it was not able to continue reporting amid a campaign of state pressure in Russia .

The investigative outlet, co-founded by late USSR chief Mikhail Gorbachev, had long been a thorn in the Kremlin's side. In recent years, it ran into increasing roadblocks amid its critical coverage of the Russian invasion of Ukraine .
It was branded a "foreign agent," a Soviet-era term resuscitated by President Vladimir Putin 's administration, with officials ordering it to vacate its Moscow offices.

Russian banks were also forbidden from processing donations from readers and supporters. The paper had been heavily dependent on this income stream after moving wholly into online publishing, with the transition taking place shortly after the invasion of Ukraine. Russian authorities introduced new wartime censorship rules in the wake of the full-scale invasion.
Nobel Prize winner Muratov calls for free speech
2021 Nobel Peace Prize -winning founding editor Dmitry Muratov issued an appeal for free speech in wartime Russia as journalists gathered in the Novaya Gazeta offices to witness its closure.

"Those in our country who advocate for peace have been denied the right to read what they choose, as we see happening today," he said. "We are currently at a point where the section of the Russian constitution that guarantees political and civil rights has ceased to function."

Russia's government meanwhile sought to play down the significance of the closure, with Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov saying it was part of a "rotational process" in a fiercely competitive media landscape.

Novaya Gazeta was a flagship for post-Soviet democratic Russia and the era of "glasnost" or openness, also launched by Mikhail Gorbachev. The reformist Soviet leader used some of the prize fund for his 1990 Nobel Peace Prize as seed money for the publication.

The paper has built a reputation for fearless reporting, which has also put it in the crosshairs of Russia's wealthy and powerful. Six of its journalists were murdered since the paper was launched in 1993.

They included Anna Politkovskaya , who spent years investigating allegations of abuses by Russia's military during its campaigns in Chechnya. An early critic of Putin, she was found dead in her apartment bloc on the president's birthday in 2006.

Images published in Russian media on Monday showed the paper's editor-in-chief, Sergei Sokolov, taking down photographs of Polikovskaya and other reporters murdered in what's thought to be retribution for their work.

Last month, when first announcing that the paper would close, Sokolov said the outlet had "been killed." The paper was shutting down after "the Russian authorities — the Russian special services — have forced the editorial team to end its work," he said.
Will closure in Moscow mark a definitive end?

Muratov called for a ceasefire in Ukraine and urged foreign observers to remember the strength of dissent that endured in Russia, even if it was being pushed underground by censorship laws and other repression or intimidation.
"We canot blame the citizens themselves for this," Muratov said, "especially the wonderful, truly remarkable younger generation."
"I urge you to distinguish between the Russian authorities and the Russian people," he added.
Muratov also called for the release of around 4,000 people he termed political prisoners in Russia.

Novaya Gazeta 's leadership has not made it entirely clear whether its closing down in Moscow marks a definitive end to the outlet's reporting, or whether they might perhaps seek to regroup and begin operating in some form from outisde Russia , as several other publications including DW have been forced to in recent years.
One of its journalists, Irina Vorobyova, said that the paper's spirit would survive like a "good virus" and would "continue in everyone that was part of it."
body_zh: 《新报》周一关闭了莫斯科办事处，称由于俄罗斯政府施压，该报无法继续报道。
这家由已故苏联领导人米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫（Mikhail Gorbachev）共同创立的调查机构长期以来一直是克里姆林宫的眼中钉。近年来，它在对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的批评报道中遇到了越来越多的障碍。
它被贴上了“外国特工”的标签，这是一个苏联时代的术语，由弗拉基米尔·普京总统政府重新启用，官员们命令它撤离莫斯科办事处。
俄罗斯银行也被禁止处理读者和支持者的捐款。该报在完全转向在线出版后，一直严重依赖这一收入来源，而这一转变是在乌克兰入侵后不久发生的。全面入侵后，俄罗斯当局出台了新的战时审查规则。
诺贝尔奖获得者穆拉托夫呼吁言论自由
2021 年诺贝尔和平奖得主、创始编辑德米特里·穆拉托夫 (Dmitry Muratov) 呼吁在战时俄罗斯实现言论自由，记者们聚集在《新报》办公室见证其关闭。
他说：“我们国家那些倡导和平的人被剥夺了阅读他们选择的内容的权利，正如我们今天所看到的那样。” “目前，俄罗斯宪法中保障政治和公民权利的部分已经停止运作。”
与此同时，俄罗斯政府试图淡化关闭的重要性，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，这是竞争激烈的媒体环境中“轮换过程”的一部分。
《新报》是后苏联民主俄罗斯和“开放”时代的旗舰，也是由米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫发起的。这位改革派苏联领导人将 1990 年诺贝尔和平奖的部分奖金用作该出版物的种子资金。
该报因无畏的报道而享有盛誉，这也使其成为俄罗斯富人和有权势人士的关注焦点。自 1993 年该报创刊以来，已有六名记者被谋杀。
其中包括安娜·波利特科夫斯卡娅（Anna Politkovskaya），她花了数年时间调查俄罗斯军队在车臣战役期间滥用权力的指控。她是普京早期的批评者，2006 年总统生日那天，她被发现死在自己的公寓楼里。
俄罗斯媒体周一发布的图片显示，该报主编谢尔盖·索科洛夫记下了波利科夫斯卡娅和其他记者被谋杀的照片，这被认为是对其工作的报复。
上个月，当索科洛夫首次宣布该报将关闭时，他表示该报已“被杀死”。他说，在“俄罗斯当局——俄罗斯特种部队——迫使编辑团队结束工作”后，该报被关闭。
莫斯科的关闭是否标志着最终的结束？
穆拉托夫呼吁乌克兰停火，并敦促外国观察家记住俄罗斯境内持续存在的异议力量，即使这些异议正被审查法和其他镇压或恐吓推入地下。
穆拉托夫说：“我们不能为此责怪公民本身，尤其是那些出色的、真正杰出的年轻一代。”
“我敦促你们区分俄罗斯当局和俄罗斯人民，”他补充道。
穆拉托夫还呼吁释放大约 4,000 名被他称为俄罗斯政治犯的人。
《新报》领导层尚未完全明确其在莫斯科的关闭是否标志着该媒体报道的最终结束，或者是否可能寻求重组并开始以某种形式在俄罗斯境外开展业务，就像近年来包括德国之声在内的其他几家出版物被迫这样做一样。
该报的一名记者伊琳娜·沃罗比奥娃(Irina Vorobyova)表示，该报的精神将像“良好的病毒”一样存活下来，并将“在每个参与其中的人身上继续存在”。

title_en: India’s demonetization: 10 years on, promises remain unfulfilled
title_zh: 印度的废钞令：十年过去了，承诺仍未兑现
summary: A decade after the 2016 currency ban, its impact on India's economy and the fight against black money remains contested.
summary_zh: 2016 年货币禁令十年后，其对印度经济和打击黑钱的影响仍然存在争议。
body_en: On November 8, 2016, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced in a televised address to the nation that he was withdrawing all 500- and 1,000-rupee banknotes from circulation at midnight.
The surprise move invalidated 86.9% of the value of currency in circulation in a single stroke.
Modi asked Indians to make a "grand sacrifice for cleansing our country."

He promised that the hardship would help eliminate black money, corruption, counterfeit currency and terrorist financing. The exercise was presented as a major step towards a cleaner and more transparent economy.
Millions of Indians rushed to banks to exchange their savings. Long queues formed outside banks and ATMs, with people waiting for hours, sometimes without knowing when they would get their money.
Workers missed wages, small businesses struggled to pay employees and families found it difficult to buy everyday essentials. Reports of people dying during the cash crisis added to the distress.

"I still remember my domestic help's father," businessman Prakash Patra from Jaipur city told DW. "He panicked, collapsed, and passed away right there, standing in a long queue just trying to exchange his family's life savings. It wasn't just cash that was lost in those lines. It was human lives."

For India's most vulnerable, particularly rural women and people without bank accounts, the sudden cash shortage made savings difficult to access. Money set aside for family weddings, medical emergencies and basic survival was suddenly compromised.
Joe Athialy, executive director of the New Delhi-based Center for Financial Accountability, a financial watchdog, says the impact fell disproportionately on the poor and the informal economy.

"Demonetization destroyed livelihoods, disrupted small businesses and pushed millions into deeper economic insecurity. The poor and those dependent on the informal sector bore the greatest cost," Athialy told DW.

Arun Kumar, former professor of economics at Jawaharlal Nehru University and author of "The Black Economy in India," shared a similar assessment. The government wrongly assumed that illicit wealth was primarily held in cash, he said.
"And it penalized the cash-dependent informal sector while leaving the real engines of the black economy untouched," Kumar told DW.
The first major setback came in 2018, when the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) reported that 99.3% of the demonetized currency had returned to the banking system.
Only a small fraction of the withdrawn money had failed to come back, undermining the expectation that large amounts of undeclared cash would be extinguished.
India's AI ambitions: Can it become a global tech superpower?

A decade later, there is little evidence that demonetization made a significant dent in black money or corruption. Economists have long pointed out that much illicit wealth in India is held in property, gold and other assets rather than cash.

Some supporters of the policy argued that forcing cash into the banking system would help formalize the economy and widen the tax base. But the extent to which these changes could be attributed to the currency withdrawal remains contested.
Lekha Chakraborty, a professor at the National Institute of Public Finance and Policy, said research after the exercise pointed to limited success in achieving its stated objectives.
body_zh: 2016 年 11 月 8 日，总理纳伦德拉·莫迪在向全国发表的电视讲话中宣布，他将于午夜停止流通所有 500 卢比和 1,000 卢比纸币。
这一出人意料的举动一下子使流通货币价值的86.9%失效。
莫迪要求印度人“为净化我们的国家做出巨大牺牲”。
他承诺，这一困难将有助于消除黑钱、腐败、假币和恐怖主义融资。这项工作被认为是迈向更清洁、更透明的经济的重要一步。
数百万印度人涌向银行兑换储蓄。银行和自动取款机外排起了长队，人们等待了几个小时，有时甚至不知道什么时候才能拿到钱。
工人们拖欠工资，小企业难以支付员工工资，家庭发现很难购买日常必需品。有关现金危机期间有人死亡的报道加剧了人们的痛苦。
来自斋浦尔市的商人普拉卡什·帕特拉（Prakash Patra）告诉德国之声：“我仍然记得我家佣的父亲。” “他惊慌失措，崩溃了，当场去世，排着长队，只是想兑换家人毕生的积蓄。在这些队伍中损失的不仅仅是现金。还有人的生命。”

对于印度最弱势群体，特别是农村妇女和没有银行账户的人来说，突然的现金短缺使得储蓄变得困难。用于家庭婚礼、医疗紧急情况和基本生存的资金突然受到损害。
总部位于新德里的金融监管机构金融问责中心执行主任乔·阿蒂亚利表示，穷人和非正规经济受到的影响尤为严重。
阿蒂亚利告诉德国之声：“废钞令破坏了生计，扰乱了小企业，并使数百万人陷入更深的经济不安全之中。穷人和依赖非正规部门的人承受着最大的损失。”
贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁大学前经济学教授、《印度的黑色经济》一书的作者阿伦·库马尔也有类似的评估。他说，政府错误地认为非法财富主要以现金形式持有。
库马尔对德国之声表示：“它惩罚了依赖现金的非正规部门，但并未触及黑色经济的真正引擎。”
第一次重大挫折发生在 2018 年，当时印度储备银行 (RBI) 报告称，99.3% 的非纸币已返回银行系统。
只有一小部分提取的资金未能返还，这削弱了大量未申报现金将被消灭的预期。
印度的人工智能雄心：能否成为全球科技超级大国？
十年后，几乎没有证据表明废钞令对黑钱或腐败产生了重大影响。经济学家长期以来一直指出，印度的许多非法财富是房地产、黄金和其他资产，而不是现金。
该政策的一些支持者认为，迫使现金进入银行系统将有助于经济正规化并扩大税基。但这些变化在多大程度上可以归因于货币撤回仍然存在争议。
国家公共财政与政策研究所教授莱卡·查克拉博蒂 (Lekha Chakraborty) 表示，演习后的研究表明，在实现既定目标方面取得的成功有限。

title_en: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted
title_zh: 南非地方选举80%选票已清点 非国大面临惨败
summary: Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling t
summary_zh: 前解放运动在全国选票中所占比例比 2021 年结果低近 14 个百分点
body_en: ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted | ANC (African National Congress)
Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result

The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.

Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994. High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to voters turning away from the party .

The former liberation movement is projected to lose its status as the biggest party in the two most populous provinces, Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal, as parties began coalition negotiations behind closed doors. The final results are expected to be announced on Sunday.

The ANC was on 31.8% of the vote nationally, almost 14 percentage points below its 2021 local election result. The centre-right, white-led Democratic Alliance (DA) had 24.1% of the vote, while the uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) party of the former ANC president Jacob Zuma was on 9.3%.
Turnout also rose in Wednesday’s poll. The election commission estimated that 54.5% of registered voters cast their ballot, up from 46% five years ago.

The final shape of coalitions in some of the country’s biggest cities remained unclear with the final votes still being counted. Senior figures in key parties said they would talk with almost anyone, while keeping negotiating strategies under wraps.

In Johannesburg, South Africa’s commercial capital and biggest city, with 4.8 million people, voters have had to contend with regular water and power cuts , uncollected rubbish and potholes. The municipality, which has seen 10 changes of mayor in the last decade amid unstable coalitions, has admitted to a 220bn rand (£9.9bn) infrastructure spending backlog.

With just over half of votes counted in Johannesburg, the DA was leading with 40%, having run an energetic campaign under Helen Zille, a 75-year-old former Cape Town mayor. The ANC, which leads the current coalition, was in second place on 17.5%. ActionSA, a rightwing party led by Herman Mashaba, was on 15.5%. Mashaba has pledged never to work with Zille, whom he calls “racist”, something she vehemently denies.

Many of the ANC’s township strongholds have yet to report full results. The Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), a respected thinktank, has projected the DA will finish with 34%, the ANC 20% and ActionSA 16.8%.
Coalitions in Gauteng’s three city municipalities are often negotiated together. The DA is leading in all three.

The MK party, led by 84-year-old Zuma as he continues to weather and deny numerous corruption allegations, is expected to displace the ANC as the largest party in KwaZulu-Natal. Founded in 2023, it mixes socially conservative Zulu nationalism with pledges to redistribute land and wealth from white to black South Africans.

With half of votes counted in eThekwini municipality, which contains Durban, the MK had 41%, meaning other parties could form a coalition to keep it out of power. Meanwhile, the DA is projected to maintain its majority in Cape Town, despite growing middle-class anger over rising housing costs .
Voters choose a local councillor and a party, with seats allocated via proportional representation. Councillors will then have two weeks to elect mayors and form municipal governments.
body_zh: 非洲人国民大会在南非地方选举中遭遇惨败，80%的选票已清点ANC（非洲人国民大会）
前解放运动在全国选票中所占比例比 2021 年结果低近 14 个百分点
非洲人国民大会在南非地方选举中势必遭遇惨败，纳尔逊·曼德拉(Nelson Mandela)领导的一度占主导地位的政党在全国选票已计入超过80%的情况下，其得票率跌至三分之一以下。
周三零散的投票标志着非国大衰落的又一个阶段。自1994年白人少数种族隔离统治结束以来，非国大一直领导着各国政府。高失业率、犯罪、腐败和糟糕的当地服务交付都导致选民远离该党。
随着各党派开始闭门进行联合谈判，前解放运动预计将失去豪登省和夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省这两个人口最多省份最大政党的地位。最终结果预计将于周日公布。
非国大在全国的选票率为 31.8%，比 2021 年地方选举的结果低近 14 个百分点。白人领导的中右翼民主联盟 (DA) 获得 24.1% 的选票，而前非国大主席雅各布·祖马 (Jacob Zuma) 领导的 uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) 政党则获得 9.3% 的选票。
周三的民意调查的投票率也有所上升。选举委员会估计，54.5% 的登记选民参加了投票，高于五年前的 46%。
该国一些最大城市的联盟的最终形态仍不清楚，最终选票仍在统计中。主要政党的高级人士表示，他们几乎会与任何人交谈，同时对谈判策略保密。
在拥有 480 万人口的南非商业首都和最大城市约翰内斯堡，选民不得不面对经常断水断电、垃圾无人收集和坑坑洼洼的问题。在过去十年中，由于联盟不稳定，该市已经更换了 10 次市长，并承认有 2200 亿兰特（99 亿英镑）的基础设施支出积压。

约翰内斯堡的选票已清点一半多一点，地方检察官在 75 岁的开普敦前市长海伦·齐勒 (Helen Zille) 的领导下开展了一场充满活力的竞选活动，以 40% 的得票率领先。领导当前联盟的非国大以 17.5% 的支持率位居第二。由赫尔曼·马沙巴 (Herman Mashaba) 领导的右翼政党 ActionSA 的支持率为 15.5%。马沙巴承诺永远不会与齐勒合作，他称齐勒为“种族主义者”，但她强烈否认这一点。
非国大的许多乡镇据点尚未报告完整结果。受人尊敬的智囊团科学与工业研究委员会 (CSIR) 预计 DA 将获得 34%、ANC 20% 和 ActionSA 16.8%。
豪登省三个城市的联盟经常一起谈判。 DA 在这三个方面都处于领先地位。
由 84 岁的祖马领导的 MK 党继续经受住并否认众多腐败指控，预计将取代非国大成为夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省最大政党。它成立于 2023 年，将社会保守的祖鲁民族主义与将土地和财富从南非白人重新分配给黑人的承诺结合在一起。
德班所在的 eThekwini 市已计票一半，MK 获得 41% 的选票，这意味着其他政党可以组成联盟来阻止其掌权。与此同时，尽管中产阶级对不断上涨的住房成本越来越愤怒，但预计DA仍将在开普敦保持多数席位。
选民选出一名地方议员和一个政党，席位通过比例代表制分配。然后，议员们将有两周时间选举市长并组建市政府。
